definitions.explanation: The surface of the earth that one walks on.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}で{地面|じめん}が{濡|ぬ}れている。
examples.english: The ground is wet from the rain.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{地面|じめん}が{揺|ゆ}れた。
examples.english: The ground shook from the earthquake.

notes:
{地面|じめん} refers to the surface of the earth or ground.

Common collocations:
- {地面|じめん}に{落|お}ちる (to fall to the ground)
- {地面|じめん}に{座|すわ}る (to sit on the ground)
- {地面|じめん}が{揺|ゆ}れる (the ground shakes)
- {地面|じめん}を{掘|ほ}る (to dig the ground)
- {濡|ぬ}れた{地面|じめん} (wet ground)

Related words:
- {地|じ}/{土|つち} (earth, soil)
- {床|ゆか} (floor - indoors)
- {大地|だいち} (the earth, the ground - more poetic)
- {地表|ちひょう} (earth's surface - scientific)
